scene: A shimmering silver key drops from the rustling leaves into your palm.
picture: Flat side view along the stone terrace. On the left sits a mossy wooden chest with a keyhole. Left of centre stands the red tea pavilion with an open doorway. Right of centre, the woman in lilac headscarf and mustard coat examines a silver key by pruned bushes. Stone steps climb right.
shown: a mossy wooden chest with a silver keyhole on the left
the open doorway of the red wooden tea pavilion at centre
steep mossy stone steps winding upward on the far right

variants.scene: A shiny silver key sparkles among the fresh tea bushes in your hand.
Holding the bright key, you wonder if this place holds clues to {quest}.
Lantern light glows as you find a curious little key beside the tea.
